title: The Ghost Goal
setup: June 27, 2010, a World Cup round-of-16 match in Bloemfontein. Germany leads England 2-1 after Matthew Upson pulled one back. Frank Lampard's shot hits the underside of the crossbar and bounces down. Television replays show it landing a yard behind the goal line. The referee waves play on.
question: Does the goal count?
options: Yes. The goal counts and it is 2-2.
The referee checks a video replay first.
ruling: No goal. The referee's decision stood and play went on. Germany won 4-1.
rulebookNote: FIFA's president, Sepp Blatter, apologized afterward and reopened the goal-line technology debate. The technology was used at the 2014 World Cup.
